other.about: Reverse placement settings (C3, classification design section 7): search counts, the rough links between flows that no flow publishes yet, and priors for causes a class leaves free.

sources.optical_depth: rough: one power law in surface pressure fitted through Earth (0.84 at 1 bar) and Venus (about 140 at 92 bar) for the grey greenhouse of sse.climate.grey_surface_temperature; it also gives Mars and Titan within a few kelvin. Replaced when an atmosphere flow publishes the optical depth
sources.shoreline: Zahnle and Catling 2017, ApJ 843, 122: the cosmic shoreline, insolation proportional to escape velocity to the fourth; v0 fitted so Mars sits on the line
sources.dose: rough: free-space galactic cosmic rays about 660 mSv/yr (Zeitlin et al. 2013, MSL cruise), halved by the planet below, attenuated with a 44 g/cm2 length so Mars's 16 g/cm2 gives its 230 mSv/yr (Hassler et al. 2014), plus 2.4 mSv/yr from the ground (UNSCEAR 2008)
sources.stability: 10 mutual Hill radii, a conservative spacing for systems lasting billions of years (Chambers, Wetherill and Boss 1996)
sources.water: liquid water between 273.15 K and the Clausius-Clapeyron boiling point, above the triple-point pressure
